title: dev gate review by Codex
description: Final answer of one /dev gate review run through scripts/codex-review.sh. Every finding carries its evidence; files_read and blocked_reason tell whether the review could look at the code at all.

checked.description: The Checked: line of the analyzer contract: probes run, candidates found and confirmed, lenses covered.

files_read.description: Number of files you actually opened and read (the input file and repository files). 0 if you could not read anything; never estimate.

blocked_reason.description: Empty if the review was carried out. Otherwise why you could not review (tool failures, timeouts, unreadable files).

file.description: Path relative to the repository root.

quote.description: The quoted line(s) from the file.

failing_input.description: The concrete input or sequence that makes it fail.
